changelog:
Superlative Memory Manager 1.0.0

- Initial release of a unified, self-optimizing memory management system for OpenClaw.
- Features auto-compaction, tiered storage (hot/warm/cold/archive), and semantic recall with vector-based queries.
- Optimizes token usage by integrating with token-efficient-agent.
- Implements zero data loss through write-ahead logging and git-based backup.
- Works automatically once enabled and supports optional manual overrides for compaction and recall.
- Requires installation of existing core memory skills for full functionality.
